svg.text: CONCEPT STUDY - PROVISIONAL DIMENSIONS - DO NOT BUILD WITHOUT REVIEW
1. Dimensions in mm. Third-angle projection. General tolerances to be defined (ISO 2768-m proposed).
2. Board outlines: maker or distributor data cited in hardware/netlist.json; others are indicative envelopes.
3. Heights, connectors and positions of openings are indicative and must be measured on the chosen parts.
4. Geometry and sheets generated by cad/generate.py (build123d 0.13.0); checks run with --check.
Redline tracker and black box, board RL-MB-01 (nRF9151)
NET LIST: 33 NETS, ALL TERMINALS UNIQUE (CHECKED)
U4.BUCK1 U1.VDD_GPIO U2.VDD U3.VDD U5.VCC U6.VCC J4.VREF
U4.GND U1.GND U2.GND U3.GND U5.GND U6.GND U7.GND C1.- +9
JST-PH 2 pins, 50 mm. Check polarity before plugging.
2. VDD of U1 and ENABLE high.
3. BUCK1 starts 1.8 V more than 6 ms later.
5. C1 charges through U7; PWR_FAIL goes high when full.
6. On a supply drop U7 keeps VSYS up and raises PWR_FAIL: last gasp.
Decoupling, RF matching, pull-ups and level parts are
added at routing; only R1 and R2 (USB-C CC pull-downs)
are modelled here because they define the connector.
